Info

 
 
 Learn More About Our Boat Rentals
 

 
 

 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 Spend some time on the water!

 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 At OB Watersports we offer the perfect pontoon boats for your family or group. From the more luxuirous tritoons, to party boat rentals with built in slides, you’re sure to find the right boat. We offer full-day and half-day rentals, and all of our pontoon boats are U.S. Coast Guard inspected and approved. Located conveniently in the heart of Orange Beach, AL, come see why OB Watersports is the perfect pontoon boat rental company for you!
Have questions? Check out our FAQs page!
